about_the_game:
🧱 Block Pile — Stack It, Smash It! 🎯

Let’s build, throw, and get a high score!
Block Pile is a fun and colorful game. It is easy to play and fun for everyone!

🕹️ How to Play

  • STACK — Put blocks on top of each other. Be careful, don’t let them fall!

  • THROW — Throw the ball to hit the blocks. Aim well!

  • MATCH & SCORE — Hit same-color blocks to get more points!

🌟 Game Features

  • Easy Controls
    Tap and play! Anyone can try!

  • Big Combos
    Hit blocks of the same color to make cool combos!

  • Play Again and Again
    Try to beat your high score every time!

  • Nice Look and Sound
    The game is colorful, and the music is happy!

  • Fun for All
    Great for kids, families, and anyone who likes puzzle games.
